claims.text: Anti-inflammatory drops and topical corticosteroids ↓inflammation; use infrequently (unclear long-term benefit; risks: glaucoma, cataracts, infections).
claims.quote: Anti-inflammatory drops and topical corticosteroids can help reduce inflammation; however, infrequent use is recommended due to the unclear long-term benefits and potential risks, including glaucoma, cataracts, and infections.
